revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Review 20261126 gps-d6: host-imports routes a guest thread's D3DIM/GL/D3D9 ring kicks to the process's one bridge (gpsProcessBridge, process-shared via worker-imports); thread-manager rethrows a GpsError from a cooperative thread instead of retiring only that thread. No guest EIP write, callback frame or invocation identity changes. General callback ownership remains pending.
